caption: The rightmost domino tips over, initiating a chain reaction. As it falls, it strikes the next domino with a gentle yet decisive push. This momentum continues, each domino toppling into the next with a rhythmic precision. The sound of each piece hitting the ground creates a soft, cascading echo in the quiet room. The sequence unfolds smoothly, each domino falling in perfect succession until the last one lies flat, completing the mesmerizing display of cause and effect.
